prompts.music: A 45-second instrumental theme for Ridge Courier, a warm playful 3D delivery buggy game on sunlit floating coastal roads. Gentle acoustic guitar plucks, woody marimba, round soft bass and light brushed percussion, 108 BPM, adventurous and welcoming, a simple memorable melodic hook, relaxed momentum. No vocals, speech or loud cinematic hits. An even beginning and ending suitable for a crossfaded game loop.
prompts.engine: A steady 4-second looping friendly compact electric delivery buggy motor. A warm soft mechanical hum with a light smooth turbine whirr, constant medium driving load. Clean isolated game sound, no traffic, wind, speech or music. Even level with no ignition or ending so it can be looped and pitch-shifted in a game.
prompts.delivery: One short friendly game delivery-complete sound, about 1 second. A soft wooden mailbox clack followed by two warm ascending marimba notes and a tiny bright bell sparkle. Clean isolated sound, no speech, no background music or ambience.
